name: CamReconciliationWorksheet
tagline: Year-end CAM and service-charge true-ups, tenant by tenant, inside Power Apps and Power Pages.
description: Allocates recoverable operating expenses to tenants with gross-up, pro-rata shares, base-year stops, cumulative and non-cumulative caps, admin fees and lease exclusions, compares the result with estimates billed and produces a per-tenant true-up statement with a review workflow, CSV export and JSON outputs for invoicing flows.
features: KPI strip: recoverable, non-recoverable, gross-up, actual charges, estimates billed, recovery ratio, net true-up
Tenants worksheet with per-pool charges, balances, status filter, search, sort and totals
Expense pools with fixed/variable lines and recoverable switches saved as overrides
Per-tenant year-end statement with base-year stop, cap reduction, admin fee and rules applied
Gross-up to target occupancy, partial-year tenants, pro-rata overrides, lease exclusions
Review workflow: pending, approved, disputed, on hold with notes
CSV export and statement/worksheet JSON outputs
Phone card list, tablet and desktop layouts; keyboard and screen-reader support
Custom labels (e.g. UK service charge), currency and accent colour
pack: Niray Real Estate & Facilities PCF Pack
